project.name: Trip Recovery Agent
project.summary: A Telegram-first autonomous recovery layer for already-booked trips that repairs safe downstream consequences and interrupts the traveler only for consequential decisions.
project.ai_usage: Gemini through Vertex AI and Google ADK handles multimodal itinerary extraction, grounded interpretation, ranking, and concise explanations. Deterministic code retains authority for policy, money, timing, state, idempotency, and verification.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported product planning, implementation, iterative Telegram QA, testing, documentation, architecture refinement, landing iteration, and submission preparation.
